## Goal

As the implementing agent for `LP-0MVN1IQTF0037WTG`, I need the failing-first unit
tests for the residency-aware admission ladder so that AC1, AC2, AC3, AC6 and AC7
(unit half) are pinned by executable, meaningful assertions before any production
code changes.

## Scope

New test module `proxy/tests/test_local_resident_prefix_admission.py` plus extensions
to existing suites. Tests are written against the *intended* API (a shared residency
view + the admission ladder), so they are added with
`@pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason="pending LP-0MVN4L7AG003PC80 / LP-0MVN4L7KT003XUBA / LP-0MVN4L7UX003KGTI / LP-0MVN4LADE001XD3M")` — the implement
skill's changed-scope gate therefore stays green, and the implementation items remove
the markers as each behaviour lands. No production code changes in this item.

Store-of-truth fixtures: a stubbed `_last_slot_details_cache` snapshot (slot_id,
is_processing, context_tokens, timestamp) and a stubbed `session._slot_owners` map.
No HTTP, no `/slots` call, no sleeps — every matrix cell is a pure function call.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC7 — Tests.** Unit coverage for: resident accept / non-resident reject, ratio boundary, tenancy bound, unknown-`context_tokens` fallback ladder, predicted-vs-actual divergence, and both reclaim bounds (this item authors those tests first).
- **AC7 (unit) — resident accept / non-resident reject:** tests assert the ladder admits a large prompt when the session's measured `reuse_ratio` is at/above `local_resident_prefix_min_ratio` and skips local with reason `resident_prefix_insufficient` when below it.
- **AC1 — ratio boundary:** a dedicated test asserts the exact boundary (`reuse_ratio == local_resident_prefix_min_ratio` admits; one token below rejects) and that `local_resident_prefix_min_ratio: 0` disables the gate entirely.
- **AC1/AC7 — unknown-`context_tokens` fallback ladder:** tests cover (a) `context_tokens` known → measured ratio used, (b) `context_tokens` `None` but the session owns the slot → treated as resident (restore path), (c) neither → non-resident, falling back to today's predicted-ratio decision.
- **AC7 — predicted-vs-actual divergence:** a test pins the 2026-10-24 failure shape — predicted `cached_ratio` 0.99 with actual `n_past=738` of a 49,103-token prompt (actual reuse ≈ 0.015) must reject, proving the live measurement supersedes the sidecar prediction.
- **AC2 — tenancy bound:** tests assert at most `local_session_tenants` distinct sessions hold a large-prompt local reservation, that a same-session re-entry is always permitted, and that the denial reason is `tenant_limit`.
- **AC6 — both reclaim bounds:** tests assert an observed disconnect releases the reservation within one ~10 s `_dispatch_cleanup_loop` cycle, and a silent half-open drop is released by the 180 s no-progress watchdog and never only at the 900 s lifetime ceiling.
- **AC3 — live-prefix pricing:** a test asserts `new_tokens` is priced from the live measurement, so a request whose live `new_tokens` exceeds the cold threshold is refused even when the predicted ratio says it is cheap.
- All new tests run through the test skill (`/skill:test`) and collect cleanly with the rest of `proxy/tests`.

## Implementation sketch

- Build a small fixture factory returning
  `(slot_snapshot, slot_owners, now)` and reuse it across all matrix cells.
- Parametrise the ladder matrix over (context_tokens known/unknown, owner yes/no,
  ratio above/below/at boundary, tenants 1/2/3, snapshot fresh/stale).
- Do not fake production internals: stub only the two documented sources
  (`_last_slot_details_cache`, `session._slot_owners`).

## Key Files

- `proxy/tests/test_local_resident_prefix_admission.py` (new)
- `proxy/tests/test_local_admission_guard.py`
- `proxy/tests/test_session_slot_affinity_continuity.py`
- `proxy/tests/test_slot_cache_ratio_restore.py`
- `proxy/tests/test_local_idle_admission.py`
- `proxy/tests/test_lease_truthfulness.py`
- `proxy/tests/test_prefill_thrash_cooldown.py`

## Dependencies

None — this is the test-first seed item; every implementation item depends on it.

## Assumptions

- `local_idle_admit_*` behaviour (`LP-0MVGD9Z8Z0055Y5J`) must keep working, so the
  idle-exempt override is a test cell in this module (it stays last in the ladder).
- The 2026-10-24 divergence numbers (49,103-token prompt, `n_past=738`) are recorded
  in the parent item's problem statement and are usable as fixture constants.

## Decomposition (parent `LP-0MVN1IQTF0037WTG`)

Sibling items created by the plan session (2026-10-25). Execute in dependency order;
test items precede implementation items.

data.description:
## Goal

As the proxy operator, I need one read-only, in-memory residency projection
(`slot_id`, `owner_session`, `context_tokens`, `is_processing`, `age`) built from
`observability._last_slot_details_cache` + `session._slot_owners`, so AC1, AC2, AC3,
AC5 and `admission_reserve.py` all reason about the *same* prefix facts with no
`/slots` call on the hot path.

## Scope

New module `proxy/proxy/residency.py` exposing one function (e.g.
`get_residency_view(now=None) -> ResidencyView`) plus a small dataclass per slot.
It copies under a snapshot (never holds a lock across an await), records snapshot age
from the cache's own timestamp, and returns an explicit `unknown` state rather than
raising when the snapshot is missing/stale. `admission_reserve.py` consumes the same
view so `POST /llama/local/reserve` and the guard agree.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 — residency view feeds the resident-prefix gate:** the view exposes, per slot, the owner session, `context_tokens` (possibly `None`), `is_processing` and the snapshot age; a unit test asserts the exact mapping from a stubbed `_last_slot_details_cache` + `_slot_owners` pair, including the multi-endpoint (`endpoint, slot_id`) key shape.
- **AC1 — no `/slots` call on the admission hot path:** a test asserts the view performs no `httpx` call and no `_query_slots_detail` invocation (monkeypatched to fail if called), honouring the `LP-0MUXTW4MD003TVIC` constraint.
- **AC1 — fail-open on unknown state:** a missing snapshot, a snapshot older than the freshness bound, or a slot with unreported `context_tokens` is reported as `unknown` (never an exception, never a fabricated context size), so the admission ladder can fall back to the session-owns-slot check and then to today's predicted-ratio decision.
- **AC1 — no lock inversion:** the view is read from a copied snapshot, so a test asserts a slot-details refresh happening concurrently cannot mutate the view mid-decision and that no asyncio lock is held across an await in the view path.
- **AC5 — decision-shape support:** the view yields every field the admission logging needs (`n_past_actual`, `slot_owner_session`, snapshot age) so the observability item logs from it rather than re-deriving.
- All new tests run through the test skill; the item's own tests are green without `xfail` markers (the view is introduced here).

## Implementation sketch

- Read `_last_slot_details_cache` under a shallow copy of dicts; pair each slot with
  `_slot_owners[(endpoint, slot_id)]`; attach `age = now - snapshot_timestamp`.
- Add a module-level freshness bound constant (the snapshot is refreshed ~1 s by
  `_periodic_broadcast_loop()`; a stale bound of a few seconds keeps decisions honest
  while remaining fail-open).
- Keep it dependency-free: no new poller, no new task, no new config knob.

data.title: [impl] Shared residency view projection

data.description:
## Goal

As a multi-turn local session, my large prompt should only be admitted locally when
my resident prefix is actually reusable — and as the proxy operator, a cold prompt
that cannot finish inside the prefill deadline must not be admitted just because a
prediction said it would be cheap.

## Scope

Implement the admission ladder in `provider._should_skip_local()` (or its replacement
entry point) using the shared residency view: (i) unchanged hard
`warm_cache_threshold` cap; (ii) **resident-prefix gate** (AC1) with the fallback
ladder; (iii) tenancy check delegated to the tenancy item; (iv) cold pricing from the
live `new_tokens` (AC3); (v) the existing idle-exempt override stays **last** so an
idle GPU still serves cold work. The 25k budget constant itself is owned by
`LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D` and is consumed, not redefined, here.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 — Resident-prefix admission gate:** before a local dispatch of a large prompt is admitted, the router computes the session's *actual* reusable prefix from live slot state and admits only when `reuse_ratio = min(context_tokens, estimated_tokens) / estimated_tokens` is `>= local_resident_prefix_min_ratio` (default `0.5`, `0` disables). Otherwise it skips local with reason `resident_prefix_insufficient` and the chain falls through as it does today, so cold prompts above the admission budget from non-resident sessions are never admitted.
- **AC3 — Live-prefix pricing:** the cold-cache gate prices `new_tokens` from the same live measurement rather than the predicted sidecar ratio (`slot_cache_ratio.py`), so the new-token cap is evaluated against real prefill work; zero admissions occur with live `new_tokens` above the cold threshold unless idle-exempt.
- **AC1 — fallback ladder (fail-open):** `context_tokens` known → measured ratio; unknown but the session owns the slot → treated as resident (restore path); otherwise → non-resident, degrading to today's predicted-ratio decision. A missing/stale snapshot never produces a hard local outage.
- **Idle-awareness preserved:** `local_idle_admit_enabled` (`LP-0MVGD9Z8Z0055Y5J`) still overrides the economic bypass for an idle GPU and remains the final rung of the ladder — a regression test asserts an idle local backend still admits cold work when the residency gate would otherwise decline.
- **No hot-path `/slots` call:** the gate consumes only the residency view; the `LP-0MUXTW4MD003TVIC` constraint is re-asserted by a unit test.
- The unit tests from the test-harness item covering AC1/AC3 lose their `xfail` markers and pass; all tests run through the test skill.

## Implementation sketch

- Add `local_resident_prefix_min_ratio` to `proxy/config.yaml` `server:` block
  (default `0.5`, `0` disables) with an inline comment documenting semantics and its
  interaction with `local_idle_admit_*` and `contention_queue_*`.
- Compute the gate before the economic `cached_ratio` computation so a rejected
  request costs nothing; keep `(skip, reason)` tuple shape for existing callers.
- Log the decision via the existing structured log line consumed by the
  observability item (do not add a new sink here; emit the fields).

data.title: [impl] Resident-prefix gate and live pricing

data.description:
## Goal

As the proxy operator, I need a bound on how many *distinct sessions* may hold a
local reservation for a large prompt at once ("N tenants, 2 slots"), so a new
session's large prompt cannot trash a resident session's KV to get a slot.

## Scope

Add the tenancy check to the local dispatch path
(`router_helpers._try_acquire_local_dispatch()` plus its release/cleanup siblings):
at most `server.local_session_tenants` (default = resolved slot count, i.e. 2)
distinct sessions may hold a large-prompt local reservation simultaneously. A new
session is admitted only when a slot is free of other sessions' prefixes, or when the
resident session's tenancy has idle-lapsed
(`server.local_session_tenancy_idle_seconds`). Beyond that bound the request follows
the normal chain rather than evicting a resident session.

**Resolved OPEN QUESTION (from the parent Appendix):** the tenancy idle-lapse default
derives from the **adaptive dispatch lease** (`local_dispatch_lease_*`, 30 s base →
1500 s cap), not from the snapshot lifetimes — one lifecycle, already tuned and
already bounded by the 180 s / 900 s watchdogs. The producer's recommended option is
adopted (no answer was supplied by the producer at planning time).

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC2 — Session tenancy ("N tenants, 2 slots").** At most `local_session_tenants` distinct sessions (default: the slot count, i.e. 2) may hold a local reservation for a large prompt at once, and a new session's large prompt is admitted only when a slot is free of other sessions' prefixes or the resident session's tenancy has idle-lapsed.
- **AC2 — tenancy denial:** a unit test asserts that at most `local_session_tenants` distinct sessions hold a large-prompt local reservation at once, that the (N+1)th distinct session's large prompt is denied with reason `tenant_limit` (following the normal fall-through chain, not evicting a resident), and that the denial does not consume the `contention_queue_*` budget differently from today's bypass path.
- **AC2 — same-session re-entry always permitted:** a test asserts a session's own second turn never waits behind its own earlier turn (existing lease semantics are preserved; tenancy only gates *new* sessions).
- **AC2 — idle-lapse releases tenancy:** a test asserts a resident session whose tenancy has exceeded `local_session_tenancy_idle_seconds` (derived from the adaptive dispatch lease) no longer blocks a new session, and that a *live* resident (data chunks / prefill progress / connected client) is never lapsed out.
- **AC2 — default is the slot count:** with `local_session_tenants` unset the bound is the resolved `session_slot_pool_size` (2); the value is configurable and non-positive/malformed values fall back to the slot count rather than disabling admission.
- **Idle-awareness + thrash-cooldown interaction unchanged:** regression tests assert `local_idle_admit_enabled` still admits on an idle GPU and that the post-deadline thrash cooldown (`LP-0MVKUKFHH005UDWL`) still applies to a tenancy-denied session.
- The AC2 unit tests from the test-harness item lose their `xfail` markers and pass through the test skill.

## Implementation sketch

- Register tenancy alongside the existing dispatch records (no new lifecycle
  machinery): a small in-memory map `session_id -> tenancy state` owned by the same
  lock that guards `local_active_queries` / `local_dispatch_records`, to preserve the
  documented lock ordering (`local_active_queries_lock` first).
- Lapse on idle using the existing adaptive lease timing source rather than a new
  timer; never extend on a merely open upstream socket.
- Add `local_session_tenants` and `local_session_tenancy_idle_seconds` to
  `proxy/config.yaml` `server:` with inline documentation.

## Key Files

- `proxy/proxy/router_helpers.py`
- `proxy/proxy/session.py`
- `proxy/proxy/provider.py`
- `proxy/proxy/admission_reserve.py`
- `proxy/config.yaml`
- `proxy/tests/test_local_resident_prefix_admission.py`
- `proxy/tests/test_session_slot_affinity_continuity.py`
- `proxy/tests/test_lease_truthfulness.py`

## Dependencies

Depends on the residency-view item and the test-harness item.

## Assumptions

- The local pool stays at 2 slots and `session_slot_pool_size: 2` for the duration of
  this work; a pool-size change (`LP-0MVN3KPEC007WWL5`) invalidates the tenancy
  default.

data.title: [impl] Session tenancy bound on dispatch

data.description:
## Goal

As a client whose connection died, I must not leave a dead session holding the
local pool: tenancy reservations must behave as leases — reclaimed by the proxy
alone, within bounded windows — and the evicted session's KV snapshot must be saved
so a returning client restores warm instead of prefilling cold.

## Scope

Make the tenancy reservation follow the existing dispatch-record lease pattern and
wire its reclaim into the existing machinery: `_dispatch_cleanup_loop` (~10 s),
the 180 s no-progress watchdog, and the 900 s lifetime ceiling. On reclaim, save the
evicted session's KV snapshot (`slot_<id>.bin`, subject to the existing pool-size and
busy gates) and free the slot assignment. No new reaper task, no client protocol
change — the proxy is the sole owner of abandonment reaping.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC6 — Tenancy reservations are leases, not locks.** Reservations follow the existing dispatch-record lease pattern: held only while real activity is observed (data chunks, prefill progress, or a live client), TTL refresh bounded by the 180 s no-progress watchdog and the 900 s lifetime ceiling, never extended by a merely open upstream socket, with reclaim via the existing ~10 s `_dispatch_cleanup_loop` and the evicted session's KV snapshot saved (`slot_<id>.bin`).
- **AC6 — reservations are leases, not locks:** a test asserts a reservation is held only while real activity is observed (data chunks, prefill progress, or a live client confirmed by the poll-cadence `request.is_disconnected()`), and that a merely open upstream socket never extends it.
- **AC6 — fast reclaim on observed disconnect:** a test asserts that when a disconnect is observed the reservation is released within one `_dispatch_cleanup_loop` cycle — record released, prefill marker popped, slot assignment freed, captured upstream `stream_cm` cancelled.
- **AC6 — bounded reclaim on a silent half-open drop:** a test asserts release within `<= 180 s` via the no-progress watchdog, and that no path lets a dead session gate the pool beyond those bounds (the 2026-10-23 ~5.5–6 min `local_lease_active` window is the regression baseline; the 900 s lifetime ceiling is never the only release path).
- **AC6 — snapshot saved on eviction:** a test asserts that on reclaim the evicted session's KV snapshot is saved as `slot_<id>.bin` subject to the pool-size and busy gates, so a returning client restores warm instead of prefilling cold.
- **AC6/AC5 — reuse the shared eviction event:** a test asserts the release path emits the **ERROR-level eviction event defined by `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D` AC7** (post-acceptance eviction = ERROR, structured reasons such as `lease_evicted` / `slot_assignment_freed`) extended with this item's tenancy-specific reasons (resident prefix evicted by another tenant, tenancy lease expired) — no second logging convention is introduced. Cross-item dependency recorded on the parent item (comment 2026-10-25T01:01:22Z).
- **AC6 — TTL refresh bounded:** a test asserts TTL refresh is bounded by the 180 s no-progress watchdog and the 900 s lifetime ceiling, and that `local_prefill_deadline_seconds` is left unchanged (backstop only; the 90→110 s change belongs to `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D`).
- The AC6 unit tests from the test-harness item lose their `xfail` markers and pass through the test skill.

## Implementation sketch

- Reuse `disconnect_reaper.py`'s observation signal rather than polling `/slots`;
  reuse the adaptive lease timing and the existing prefill marker bookkeeping.
- Extend `_cleanup_stale_local_dispatch()` to release tenancy in the same pass as the
  dispatch record so the two cannot diverge.
- Call the existing `_save_slot_snapshot` / `_free_slot_assignment` helpers on
  reclaim; do not add a new save path.
- Emit the eviction record through the shared event from `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D`
  AC7 (extend its structured `reason` vocabulary) — never a parallel logger call.

## Goal

As the proxy operator, I want, per admission decision, the measured reusable prefix
and which session owned the slot — and as the capacity analyst, I want the usage
report to split resident-vs-evicted reuse and show slot-owner churn per session — so
residency regressions are visible without forensics.

## Scope

Emit the new fields on the existing structured log lines (no new sink) and extend the
usage report. Fields: `n_past_actual`, `estimated_tokens`, `reuse_ratio`,
`slot_owner_session`, and `decision` (`admit` / `resident_prefix_insufficient` /
`tenant_limit`) at `routing_skip_local` / `routing_hop` level. Extend
`.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/analyze_proxy_usage.py` with a
resident-vs-evicted reuse section and per-session slot-owner churn.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC5 — Observability.** Every admission denial and admission logs `n_past_actual`, `estimated_tokens`, `reuse_ratio`, `slot_owner_session`, and the decision (`admit` / `resident_prefix_insufficient` / `tenant_limit`) at `routing_skip_local` / `routing_hop` level, and the `proxy-usage-analysis` report surfaces resident-vs-evicted reuse splits and slot-owner churn per session.
- **AC5 — every admission denial and admission logs the decision:** a test asserts each local admission/denial emits `n_past_actual`, `estimated_tokens`, `reuse_ratio`, `slot_owner_session` and `decision` at `routing_skip_local` / `routing_hop` level, including the fail-open path (unknown `n_past_actual` logs an explicit unknown rather than a fabricated number).
- **AC5 — report surfaces residency splits:** `analyze_proxy_usage.py` reports resident-vs-evicted reuse splits (reuse under a stable slot owner vs reuse after an owner change) and slot-owner churn per session, and the report's existing sections and CLI contract are unchanged for older log windows.
- **AC5 — report test:** a deterministic test over a fixed log fixture asserts the new section's counts and that an empty/legacy log window degrades gracefully (no crash, section marked unavailable).

## Goal

thrash window that the new ladder refuses over-budget cold admissions and classifies

## Scope

admission verdicts) into the 2026-10-24 fixture driver: replay the pinned window,
recompute each request's verdict against the residency view reconstructed from the

## Goal

As the proxy operator, I need the change shipped safely and AC4's verification
vehicle armed correctly at deploy time, so the 24 h regression check can actually run
and the full-suite gate proves nothing else broke.

## Scope

Staged rollout of the ladder behind the documented knobs, the dev-push full-suite
gate (AC9), and the AC4 deliverable: retitle `LP-0MVN44XB0009M33K` from the provable
lower bound (`run no earlier than 2026-10-26T00:51Z`) to the deploy-derived instant —
the later of this item's deploy and `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D`'s deploy, plus 24 h — and
record the pinned measurement window, the baseline re-anchoring query and the
scheduling-attributed classifier in that item.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC4 — Deadline/thrash regression (re-anchored), verified by a mandatory follow-up work item.** On a 24 h window measured after `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D` is deployed, scheduling-attributed `prefill_deadline_exceeded` events are >= 90 % below that window's own re-anchored baseline, with verification executed by the follow-up item `LP-0MVN44XB0009M33K` (this item arms it and never substitutes its own measurement).
- **AC4 (deliverable) — follow-up verification item armed:** `LP-0MVN44XB0009M33K` is retitled to `24 h AC4 verification of resident-prefix admission — run no earlier than <ISO-8601 UTC instant>`, where the instant is max(deploy of this item, deploy of `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D`) + 24 h; its description records the pinned window (start/end UTC), the baseline re-anchoring query, the `proxy-usage-analysis` invocation and the scheduling-attributed classifier, and it stays linked `discovered-from:LP-0MVN1IQTF0037WTG` and related to `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D`. AC4 itself is satisfied only by that item's 24 h result, never by this session's measurements.
- **AC9 — Full project test suite passes** with the new changes at the dev-push gate (no ad-hoc full-suite runs during implementation; the gate and the test skill own execution).
- **AC4 — pending-deploy arithmetic is explicit:** if `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D` has not deployed when this item ships, the retitle records the arithmetic with that term marked pending (and a comment on both items), and the follow-up item is re-armed with the concrete instant once that deploy is known — the follow-up must never run before *both* deploys + 24 h.

- **AC4 — Title format:** the follow-up item `LP-0MVN44XB0009M33K` is retitled to `24 h AC4 verification of resident-prefix admission — run no earlier than <ISO-8601 UTC instant>`, where the instant is max(this item's deploy, `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D`'s deploy) + 24 h.

- **AC4 — Linked `discovered-from:LP-0MVN1IQTF0037WTG` and related to `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D`**, assigned to the operator's triage queue.
- **AC4 — AC4 is not satisfied by the implementing agent's own measurements:** it is satisfied only when the follow-up item reports its 24 h result across a pinned window measured after both deploys.

  `LP-0MVN3KMGI009BZ0D` deploy record.

## Goal (user story)

As an operator, I want the parent item's gating precondition verified from
measured evidence, so that prefill tuning only starts once local actually
carries sustained work.

## What the gate is

Parent **LP-0MVMHNUAR006SRZT** AC0 requires a comment recording a measured
**>60 % local (GPU) busy** night before any change is made. Busy is the
`## Local model utilization` upper bound (dispatch -> finish: prefill +
decode) from the deterministic `proxy-usage-analysis` CLI, over a complete
night window (22:00-07:00 local).

## Evidence at planning time (2026-10-25)

- Night **2026-10-23 22:00 -> 2026-10-24 07:00**: busy **2.2 %** (719 s of
  32 400 s; 27 local streams; prefill 336 slot-s; decode 383 slot-s;
  idle 97.8 %).
  Command:
  `python3 .pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/analyze_proxy_usage.py --log-dir /var/log/llama-proxy --start "2026-10-23 22:00:00" --end "2026-10-24 07:00:00" --output-dir /tmp/wl-gate-check --json`
- Same night in the 24 h daily report (`~/proxy-usage-reports/report.md`,
  window 2026-10-23 10:52 -> 2026-10-24 10:52): busy 10.2 %.

**The gate is NOT met.** The parent is left `blocked` at stage
`plan_complete`, and every other child of this plan depends on this item, so
none of them is dispatchable until the gate passes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC0: The gate AC is satisfied - a comment on this item records the measured >60% GPU utilisation for a full night, from the usage-analysis report, before any change is made.
- AC1: A comment on the parent records local busy % for a **complete** night
  window (22:00-07:00), with the exact CLI invocation, the window bounds and
  the artifact directory used.
- AC2: The gate is declared met **only** when `busy_pct >= 60` for the whole
  night (`definition: dispatch_to_finish` in the CLI `--json` summary).
- AC3: When the gate is not met this item stays **open and incomplete** with
  the evidence comment (recorded `blocked` status is derived from dependency
  edges in `wl` and cannot be pinned, so this item is the lock: keeping it
  incomplete keeps every dependent child dependency-blocked), and no other
  child of the plan is started.
- AC6: This item must never be marked `completed` while the gate is unmet. If a
  run cannot leave it open, it records the evidence and files the deferral on
  the parent rather than completing the gate.
- AC4: When the gate is met this item completes with the evidence comment and
  the parent plus its dependent siblings are unblocked in the same update
  sequence.
- AC5: Measurement only - no configuration, flag or code change.

**Key Files:**
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/analyze_proxy_usage.py` - deterministic report CLI
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/REFERENCE.md` - report section definitions

## Dependencies

None. All other children of this plan depend on this item.
